status: Status: frozen (ADR-0119). Assigned values are immutable; a 'reserved...' construction may be filled once.
rules: CryptoProfile ids are uint 1..65535 and never reused. 0 is reserved (never valid). 1..32767 public; 32768..65279 reserved; 65280..65535 experimental/test (never accepted by a production build).

A profile id names a reviewed bundle of constructions (CRYPTOGRAPHY_AND_AGILITY.md); it never names an individual primitive. Status lifecycle: experimental -> allowed -> preferred -> deprecated -> forbidden (PROTOCOL_EXTENSIBILITY.md §6).
hash_alg ids are used by the Digest struct and are bound to profiles; 1 = SHA-256 for OM-Crypto-v1.

security_generation (ADR-0126) maps a conversation type (one_to_one, group) to an unsigned integer. The downgrade floor compares this value for the conversation type in question, never profile ids. A profile without an entry for a type cannot be used for that type. A generation is assigned once and never changed.

The only floor movement that is not an increase: a SecurityAdvisory marks a profile 'forbidden'; the floor then moves to a non-forbidden profile of equal or higher security_generation, never lower. There is no other exception.
required_bundle_fields (ADR-0126) lists AsyncKeyBundle fields that must be present for bundles of that profile.

profiles.name: OM-Crypto-v1
profiles.note: PQXDH (X25519 + ML-KEM-768) + Double Ratchet; no SPQR/PQ post-compromise healing in v1. Device binding requires Ed25519 + ML-DSA-65. DR payload AEAD AES-256-GCM-SIV. MessageRequest HPKE pins draft-ietf-hpke-pq-05 MLKEM768-X25519/HKDF-SHA256/ChaCha20Poly1305 base mode (ADR-0131).

profiles.name: insecure-test-profile
profiles.note: Used only by V-005 vectors: signature bytes are fixed placeholders (insecure_test_signature). Must be rejected by any production build.
